name: Frankfort (Indiana, United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and dark blue divided by wavy lines, with a white diamond in the upper hoist for the city's nickname, the Gem City.
history: Frankfort is a city in Clinton County, Indiana. The flag was adopted in 2023 (designed by a seventh-grader, Redman Porter, and presented to Mayor Judy Sheets in April 2023, according to Flags of the World; the light blue stands for the Frankfort lagoons and the dark blue for Prairie Creek).
